title: Leaks and air intrusion
summary: Reviews in this topic describe several leak-related problems, including air entering through doors or the cabin, water near mirror assemblies, and brake fluid leaking after driving.

negative.summary: Negative reviews report air leaks through doors or into the cabin, water leaking into or behind mirror assemblies, and brake fluid leaking after a long drive.

limitations: This topic combines different leak types and affected areas, so the examples do not point to a single coherent issue.
Only a small set of review fragments is available, so examples are insufficient to describe conditions, repairs, or recurrence in detail.
